lines: Goff's passing has dropped lately: 27.0 attempts per game over his last 3, down from 33.8 on the season, and 216.3 yards per game versus 270.8.

Week 11 is against TB, which allows the 30th-most PPR points per game to QBs. Detroit's implied team total is 26.0 points.
